headlines.title: Netflix Just Hit a 52-Week Low. Where’s the Bottom?

headlines.title: Ibotta Appoints Kamelia Aryafar to Board of Directors
headlines.summary: DENVER, November 17, 2026--Ibotta, Inc. (NYSE: IBTA), North America’s leading digital promotions network, today announced the appointment of Kamelia Aryafar to its Board of Directors. Kamelia brings more than 15 years of experience researching and building AI for leading consumer and enterprise applications across consumer technology, e-commerce, and enterprise software. With her appointment, Larry W. Sonsini has stepped down from Ibotta’s Board, effective November 15, 2026.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
